figure: Extended Data Fig. 5 | On 217 out-of-array amide pairs the amine again owns
randomness: 2,000 molecule resamples, default_rng(20261004), the generator's first draws

transformation.a: Product-forming amide pairs of SA1 (best measured yield at least 10%). Condition pattern = residual after an intercept and slope on the condition means of these pairs; share of a role = mean product of the patterns of pairs sharing only that molecule / mean pattern variance; 'neither' = the same for pairs sharing no molecule.
transformation.b: 2,000 resamples of the molecules of each role (anatomy.molecule_weights) with the generator default_rng(20261004), drawn before any other use of it; each resample's margin = amine share minus acid share. 95% interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles (linear interpolation); the fraction of resamples with a positive margin.
